verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents isolated cloud sandboxes (docs-1) and official Go/Python/TypeScript SDKs plus a raw HTTP API authenticated with a team API key (docs-37). Its docs describe claiming a sandbox, with a TTL or from a snapshot, as a single operation (docs-38, docs-29), so one-call provisioning is supported. The 'live in seconds' half is unevidenced: no cold-start or provisioning latency figures are given, and the docs say resume 'takes time and requires available capacity' (docs-4). Missing for 10: documented sandbox startup/claim latency, a concrete one-call create example in the SDK docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-live-environment.
